reuse.why: The rule change is made inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, which every forecast, posting, preview and UI path already calls.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the diff edits two expressions in the single shared helper and only updates comments elsewhere.

placement.why: The amount rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the tree already defines it, and callers are untouched.

scope.why: Only the helper, its tests and the now-stale comments at call sites are changed.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount - tolerance express the new 'lowest value' rule directly in one place with matching tests.
